exposure: pregnant smokers with and without PCOS
pregnant women with PCOS who did smoke vs. pregnant women with PCOS who did not smoke
cohort: Pregnant women with polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) from the HCUP-NIS database (2004-2014)
finding: Smoking during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of developing gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in women with PCOS.
